title: Anyone can get another 3-month free trial by making a new gym with the same mobile
what: Create my gym gives every new gym 3 free months unless a WhatsApp-checked number is sent. The number check is behind a switch that is off, and the panel falls back to making the gym without it. So an owner whose trial ended can make a fresh gym with the same number, import his members again, and use Pro free for another 3 months, as often as he likes (5 gyms an hour from one internet address).
expected: One free trial per mobile number: a number that already owns a gym or already had a trial gets no new free months, whether or not the WhatsApp check is on.
how_often: every time an owner makes another gym
fix_line: Give the free months only to a number that has never owned a gym or had a trial, even without the WhatsApp check

title: The front desk can add or remove check-ins for any day with no name kept, and check-ins now win challenge prizes
what: The gym server takes any check-in the panel sends from a front-desk login: any member, any day (past or future), and it lets the desk delete any check-in. It does not keep who added or removed it. A check-in challenge counts these days, so a desk person can make a friend reach the goal and win free days. The owner sees a winner to Give or Skip, but nothing shows the visits were typed in by hand or by whom.
expected: A desk check-in is for today (a day of grace at most), keeps who added it, and only the owner can remove one from an earlier day, like the PT session rule.
how_often: whenever a desk person chooses to
fix_line: Let the desk save check-ins only for today, stamp who saved them, and keep taking back an older one for the owner

items.reason: No AI is called from the sign-in and records folders: the only AI words are a support-log label and the owner-only page rule; the import money preview runs the import in memory with no AI
